_about: GET /drawings/{id}/status, contract 1.2 + optional store fields (WP2). Existing fields are unchanged: contract_version, id, status (queued | processing | ready | failed), progress (0..1, only while processing), error. Every field below is OPTIONAL; a client that ignores them keeps working. Poll every 1-2 s while `status` is queued/processing OR `stage` is one of reading/interpreting/materialising; stop on any other stage.

fields.stage: queued | parsing | reading | interpreting | materialising | indexed_store | indexed_ours | ready_unindexed | partial | store_failed | failed. The upload is usable (status ready) from `reading` on: our own fast parse answers already; the store stages then enrich it.
fields.mode: full | quick. quick = no drawing store (AURA_STORE_DSN unset or Postgres down): uploads end at ready_unindexed (PDF/PNG) or indexed_ours (DXF/IFC).
fields.pages: [{drawing_id, page (1-based), label?, stage, file_id?, counts?, error?}] one entry per bundle page (a multi-page PDF yields one drawing per page: up-<tok>, up-<tok>-p2, ...). Single-page uploads have one entry. The top-level stage is the least advanced page stage (failures rank last).
fields.counts: {rooms?, apartments?, doors?, windows?, fixtures?, texts?, pages?} items found so far, summed over pages. Interpretation counts appear at materialising/indexed_store; earlier only texts/pages (raw layer-1 reads).
fields.note: short human sentence for the current stage or the reason of a failure/partial; never a stack trace, URL or secret.
fields.ingest_calls: int, model requests the store spent on this upload (symbol detection). 0 when nothing was detected by a model.
fields.ingest_cost_usd: float, USD of those requests where token usage is known; absent when unknown.
fields.elapsed_s: int, seconds since the upload was accepted.
fields.stage_s: int, seconds spent in the current stage (the upload page shows it next to an indeterminate bar).

stage_rules.queued: status queued; waiting for a parse slot
stage_rules.parsing: status processing; our parse/render (progress is real here: 0..1)
stage_rules.reading: status ready; the store reads the file (layer 1: vectors, text, OCR). store row status registered
stage_rules.interpreting: status ready; the store derives rooms, doors, windows, fixtures (layer 2; may call Gemini for symbols). store row parsed + a worker is on it
stage_rules.materialising: status ready; writing the store's result into the drawing (seconds)
stage_rules.indexed_store: final, full mode, PDF/PNG: rooms/doors/windows from the store; model-detected items are labelled estimates
stage_rules.indexed_ours: final, DXF/IFC uploads: our CAD/IFC solvers own rooms and openings (the store is still filled for the sql tool when mode=full)
stage_rules.ready_unindexed: final, quick mode PDF/PNG: viewable and askable, no rooms index; answers that need rooms abstain or estimate
stage_rules.partial: final, full mode: layer 1 is in the store but interpretation stopped (no worker on it any more); answers use what was read
stage_rules.store_failed: final, full mode: the store could not read the file; the drawing stays usable from our parse (as ready_unindexed)
stage_rules.failed: final, status failed: our own parse failed; nothing usable

body.note: Reading the file into the drawing store
Writing the result into the drawing
Indexed: rooms from the PDF vectors; doors, windows and fixtures are model estimates

dxf_upload_full_mode.note: Rooms and openings from the CAD geometry (exact)

quick_mode_pdf.note: Quick mode: no drawing store, so rooms are not indexed for this PDF

store_failed.note: The drawing store could not read this file; it stays viewable, without a rooms index

pages.error: The file could not be read

partial.note: Text and lines were read; finding rooms stopped before it finished

failed.error: The PDF could not be opened.
failed.note: The file could not be read
